evidence.floralLogic: 15/15 authored Milestone 5 Node-style test bodies executed on exact GitHub branch source in a V8 assertion shim; NOT genuine Node.
evidence.floralCrossLane: 39/39 V8 opt-in targeting and surface mesher probes passed: 28 shapes × rotation; 204–376 triangles per unmerged prototype; ten nontrivial targeting/space/mount/light consistency probes; source gallery syntax parsed. NOT production WebGL2.
evidence.floralPreview: Standalone HTML+JS gallery source committed with seven actual box-derived Canvas2D specimens, cross-section probes, rotate/place/remove and canonical fixture save/restore; authentic Chromium screenshots NOT CAPTURED.

integrationDependencies: Production VoxelWorld.set() rejects IDs greater than 8. Manual integration must expand registry and rendering atomically without changing schema-1 layout.
Existing production mesh/collision is whole-cube only. Core masonry uses full cubes; future shaped pieces depend on :12 shape engine and :00 targeting/collision.
No world placement or live UI wiring is authorized.
Existing Stone 3 and Deepstone 8 remain untouched. Shader-only masonry treatments are not physical blocks.
